## 1 Overview

Using GWmodel using sp dataframe

## 2 Loading the Data

### 2.1 Importing packages into R environment


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, ggstatsplot, tmap, tidyverse, knitr, GWmodel)
```
:::


### 2.2 Importing shapefile into R environment


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sf <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
                 layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

  `C:\emmachew\ISSS626-emma-chew-en-chin\Hands-on Exercise\Hands-on_Ex4\data\geospatial' 
  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'

```


:::
:::


### 2.3 Importing csv into R environment


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::


Left Join Hunan and Hunan 2012 dataset


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sf <- left_join(hunan_sf, hunan2012) %>%
  select(1:3, 7, 15, 16, 21, 32)
```
:::


Convert to sp


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sp <- hunan_sf %>%
  as_Spatial()
```
:::


### 3 Mapping GDPPC


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
basemap <- tm_shape(hunan_sf) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_text("NAME_3", size=0.5)

gdppc <- qtm(hunan_sf, "GDPPC")
tmap_arrange(basemap, gdppc, asp=1, ncol=2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex4_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sp <- hunan_sf %>%
  as_Spatial()
```
:::


### 3 Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics

:::: panel_tabset
::: {style="font-size: 1.20em"}
### Cross Validation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_CV <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1, 
             data = hunan_sp,
             approach = "CV",
             adaptive = TRUE, 
             kernel = "bisquare", 
             longlat = T)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

```

:::


### AIC


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_AIC <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1, 
             data = hunan_sp,
             approach ="AIC",
             adaptive = TRUE, 
             kernel = "bisquare", 
             longlat = T)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 62 AICc value: 1923.156 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 46 AICc value: 1920.469 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 36 AICc value: 1917.324 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 29 AICc value: 1916.661 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 26 AICc value: 1914.897 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 22 AICc value: 1914.045 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 22 AICc value: 1914.045 
```


:::
:::


### GWSS


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
               vars = "GDPPC",
               bw = bw_AIC,
               kernel = "bisquare",
               adaptive = FALSE,
              longlat = T)
```
:::

:::

### 3.1 Extract SDF Data table from GWSS object output


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF)
```
:::


`cbind()` joins two tables with same row sequence without an ID (join) column.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df)
```
:::
